title: BREAD AND BULLETS
description: The Oppressive tax rate has broken the back of the working class. Riots have erupted in the industrial sector of Aldmark. The mob has seized a munitions depot and is demanding immediate tax relief, or they will detonate the stockpile.

title: ALDMARK MUNITIONS BLAST
description: During the military crackdown, a stray bullet struck a volatile artillery shell casing. The resulting explosion leveled three city blocks and severed the central rail line.

title: THE VOSK SCIENTIST
description: A high-ranking Vosk engineer has defected across the frozen Frontier. He offers the complete blueprints for their experimental Cold-Weather Equipment, but demands 150,000 CR to start a new life in neutral Oakhaven.

choices.label: Pay the man. We need that tech.
Throw him in a black site and extract it.

title: R&D BREAKTHROUGH: WINTER GEAR
description: The defector arrived safely in Oakhaven. True to his word, our agents recovered a dead-drop containing the schematics. Our R&D department can now mass-produce Winter Gear.

choices.label: Issue it to the men immediately.

title: DEFECTOR FOUND DEAD
description: The Vosk scientist died during our 'enhanced interrogation'. The blueprints were in his head, and now they are gone forever. The intelligence community is shaken.

title: THE GHOST SHIP
description: A Kestrian merchant marine vessel has drifted into the port of Brenmouth. The crew is dead or dying from a horrific, highly contagious strain of Cholera. Port authorities beg you to sink the ship before it docks.

choices.label: Sink the ship. God rest their souls.
We cannot murder our own citizens. Quarantine them.

title: QUARANTINE BREACHED
description: The port quarantine failed. Desperate sailors bribed the guards and escaped into Brenmouth. The infection is now spreading rapidly through the coastal population.
